channel.title: Bainbridge Island Review - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Bainbridge Island Review (bainbridgereview.com)

item.title: ‘They feel like themselves again:’ Innovation restores dental function and confidence
item.description: Bainbridge Island’s Dr. Helena Soomer Lincoln creates dental restoration system with life-changing results

item.title: Olympic College narrows president search to four finalists
item.description: Olympic College announced March 3 that it has narrowed its search down to four finalists for consideration as the school’s next president.

item.title: Schroer to serve as interim city manager while search continues
item.description: The Bainbridge Island City Council approved at its Feb. 24 meeting to have deputy city manager Ellen Schroer serve as the interim city manager while the search continues to fill the permanent position following Blair King’s retirement Jan. 30.

item.title: New program aims to help BI residents, businesses transition to solar
item.description: The City of Bainbridge Island, in partnership with nonprofit Olympia Community Solar, has launched Solarize Bainbridge Island, a limited-time solar group purchasing program designed to make installing solar energy systems simple, affordable, and accessible for the community.

item.title: BI to revive Environmental Technical Advisory Committee
item.description: The sun may rise again on the Environmental Technical Advisory Committee (ETAC), per a unanimous decision made by the Bainbridge Island City Council at its Feb. 24 meeting.

item.title: BIFD still vetting concerns of 305/High School Rd roundabout
item.description: The Bainbridge Island Fire Department Board of Commissioners reviewed an update about the department’s responses to accidents at the intersection of Highway 305 and High School Road, the future proposed site of a roundabout, as part of its Feb. 25 meeting.

item.title: Council ward meetings may return by late March
item.description: Bainbridge Island city councilmembers may start hosting meetings with their constituents again, after city leaders gave staff the green light to start carving out time on official schedules.

item.title: Kitsap 911 working to fill dispatcher vacancies
item.description: Kitsap 911, the agency that handles 911 services in Kitsap County, is working to fill six dispatcher positions.

item.title: BISD could issue tax ‘refund’ for island residents
item.description: Taxpayers on Bainbridge Island could receive a $1.3 million break as soon as June 1 — though not all at once.
